name: Patrick Dandy
original_name: パトリック・ダンディ
source: The titular protagonist of the hidden PSP-exclusive "Patrick Dandy" scenario. He is a US Army colonel who calls himself an astronaut, but his appearance, words, and actions makes him appear suspicious. He claims to be 48 years old, an aristrocrat connected to the British royal family and Russian Romanov dynasty, and also that he's being pursued by the CIA.
